BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.

4. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

6. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

7. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

11. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

12. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

14. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

15. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

16. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
